title: Pin one production callable contract
objective: Prove the exact SGLang callable, ABI, layout, wrapper work, fallback, commit, and execution mode that one candidate must replace.
preconditions: A named served operator or region
Access to the target SGLang source and deployment configuration
steps: Trace eager and graph call paths from the served request
Record shapes, strides, dtype, scale packing, cache layout, dispatch predicates, fallback, and adjacent wrapper work
Save SGLang commit, hardware, topology, and launch flags

acceptance.pass: One reproducible contract names the same boundary for correctness, timing, and cost.
acceptance.invalid: Any ABI field or production branch is inferred rather than observed.

stop_rule: Do not implement or benchmark a replacement until the production boundary is pinned.
origin_evidence: The campaign repeatedly compared synthetic f32 scale paths against production packed int32 UE8M0 paths.
